result.brief: 提出两阶段框架 PhysForce，将力（位置、方向、幅值）编码进视频潜空间，并用物理归因网络与物理感知强化学习提升交互式视频世界模型的力响应与物理一致性。
result.reason: Interactive video world model with force-conditioned latent intervention encoder and physics attribution in latent space; directly contributes to action-conditioned video world modeling and latent representation design.
